title: Kouman
tagline: Kouman is an entertaining Iranian YouTube series hosted by Kourosh, Iman, and Mi
synopsis:
Kouman is an entertaining Iranian YouTube series hosted by Kourosh, Iman, and Mia, with new episodes released every Friday. The show is primarily focused on fun challenges and food tasting. In each episode, they engage in exciting competitions, blind taste tests, comparing cheap versus expensive items, and reviewing bizarre gadgets. With its humorous and friendly atmosphere, Kouman delivers hilarious moments for its audience, occasionally featuring travel vlogs to explore and taste local cuisines
